adjacent-trunk-plane.description: Transverse trunk section at or near the thoraco-abdominal junction (oblique cut showing both ribs/heart and liver/stomach); Abdomen and Thorax are confused in both directions

round-rim-skull-like.description: Round cross-section with a bright continuous rim (ribs, spine or stomach wall) that resembles a skull outline; predicted Brain, or a Brain plane whose rim is interrupted

bone-like-structure.description: A prominent long, bright bone-like structure (rib, spine, diaphragm) attracts the Femur class, or a femur image with a round soft-tissue mass next to the bone attracts Brain

atypical-acquisition.description: Oblique head section or a limb occluding part of the head (hand in front of the face)

low-image-quality.description: Very grainy, low-contrast image (cardiac preset, high gain) with no recognisable landmarks
